title: 第681章 你跟苍月和谐吗第680章 叶云的选择
slug: 人在废丹房我以丹药证道成仙
content_zh:
至于……为什么说是部分真相，自然是因此事不宜全说出来。
其中关于妖物的母体所在，若是说就在他们手中，那事情可就说不清了。
到时候，各方势力在统计损失的时候，难免不会把罪责扣在他们头上。
说什么不早点干掉母体，才导致事情发展到这一步。
至于他们是何时知道，这母体会感染出子体，没人会在意这种事情。
他们只会觉得，是古道圣地故意为之，才导致的现状……
“这……我回头试试看。”
叶云沉吟了一番，给出了回答。
想想也是，守夜人组织，本就是为各方利益而结成。
现在除去升仙教，又冒出来一个可能威胁大陆，危害各方的东西。
不出意外，应该也能联合到一起行动。
“既如此，你便辛苦一下了。”
金琉璃对其赞许的点了下头。
在交谈一番后，叶云与红仙儿一同离去。
两人来到禁地之外，彼此看了一眼。
这时候，叶云好奇问道。
“仙儿，你接下来是回去还是……”
红仙儿思索了下。
而后，她缓缓摇头。
“今日事务大多处理完，就先去你的造化峰待一阵吧。”

叶云眼前一亮，立马明白了她的想法。
“好咧，那快走吧！”
说着，他便牵起红仙儿的手。
见此情形，红仙儿挑眉道。
“你这家伙，未免也太急不可耐了吧？”
对于她的吐槽，叶云轻笑道。
“这不是太久，没跟仙儿一同修炼了吗？难道亲爱的娘子就不想要？”
闻言，红仙儿微微转头，轻哼一声。
“我可没你那么欲求不满。”
在男女之事的欲望上，她自然是比叶云稍低一些。
当然，要是被撩起心中之火，那情况可就要反过来了。
叶云并未反驳她，只是笑了下道。
“是是是，咱家仙儿最是清冷了。”
“那是自然。”
红仙儿柳眉微动，淡淡开口。
不久之后，两人便来到造化峰。
门口的许轻烟，见到他们连忙行了一礼。
“叶长老，圣主大人。”
叶云与红仙儿点头致意。
待到进去，红仙儿转头看了一眼门口方向。

随即，她对叶云无奈道。
“我说你这家伙，用一个筑道境强者，在这里给你看大门。”
“不觉得，有点暴殄天物了吗？”
叶云摊了下手，一脸认真的道。
“这话说的，要是不够强的话，拿什么守得住大门？”
content_en:
As for... why it is said to be part of the truth, naturally it is not appropriate to tell the whole story.
Regarding the location of the monster's mother body, if it is said that it is in their hands, then the matter cannot be explained clearly.
When the time comes, when all parties count their losses, they will inevitably not pin the blame on them.
It's said that the mother body was not killed earlier, which led to things developing to this point.
As for when they knew that the mother body would infect the offspring, no one would care about such a thing.
They will only think that the current situation was caused by the deliberate actions of the Ancient Holy Land...
"This... I'll try it later."
Ye Yun pondered for a while and gave his answer.
Think about it, the Night Watch organization was originally formed for the benefit of all parties.
Now, in addition to the Shengxian Sect, another thing has emerged that may threaten the mainland and harm all parties.
Not surprisingly, they should be able to unite and act together.
"In that case, you have to work hard."
Jin Liuli nodded approvingly.
After a conversation, Ye Yun and Hong Xianer left together.
The two came outside the forbidden area and looked at each other.
At this time, Ye Yun asked curiously.
"Xian'er, are you going back next or..."
Hong Xian'er thought for a moment.
Then, she slowly shook her head.
"After finishing most of today's affairs, let's go to your Creation Peak for a while."
Ye Yun's eyes lit up and he immediately understood what she was thinking.
"Okay, let's go now!"
With that said, he took Hong Xian'er's hand.
Seeing this situation, Hong Xian'er raised her eyebrows and said.
"You guys are too impatient, aren't you?"
Regarding her complaints, Ye Yun chuckled.
"Hasn't it been too long since you haven't practiced with Xian'er? Don't you, my dear lady, want it?"
Hearing this, Hong Xian'er turned her head slightly and hummed softly.
"I'm not as horny as you are."
In terms of desire for things between men and women, she is naturally slightly lower than Ye Yun.
Of course, if the fire in your heart is aroused, the situation will be reversed.
Ye Yun did not refute her, just smiled and said.
"Yes, yes, our Xian'er is the coldest."
"That's natural."
Hong Xian'er's eyebrows moved slightly and she spoke calmly.
Soon after, the two came to Creation Peak.
Xu Qingyan, who was at the door, bowed quickly when she saw them.
"Elder Ye, Lord Holy Master."
Ye Yun and Hong Xian'er nodded in greeting.
After entering, Hong Xianer turned her head and glanced in the direction of the door.
Then, she said helplessly to Ye Yun.
"I told you, you, use a Taoist Realm expert to show you the gate here."
"Don't you think it's a bit of a waste of natural resources?"
Ye Yun spread his hands and said seriously.
"As you say, if you are not strong enough, how can you hold the door?"
